basis: “Check it” does not distinguish consulting MigrationDirectoryFS from checking the configured directory or URL. Naming the API clarifies the required preliminary check without inventing return-value handling.
replacement:
`projectconfig.Config.MigrationDirectoryFS` returns the immutable
filesystem behind a resolved `data.template_dir` URL; a host that consumes the
configured migration directory should consult `MigrationDirectoryFS` before
opening the URL as an ordinary directory.
